title: Tensor-normalized scalar stage coherence on the specified older rational presentation
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and any scheme $Y$; no structure map from $Y$ to $k$ is assumed. Let $I$ be the finite coefficient subfields of $\Omega$ [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. For $E\in I$, fix the small model $\widetilde E=\mathrm{Shrink}(E)$ and its algebra equivalence $s_E:\widetilde E\cong E$, and put $i_{EL}=s_L^{-1}\circ(E\hookrightarrow L)\circ s_E$. Let $\mathcal A_E^{\mathrm{old}}$ be the full subcategory of the completed integral derived category whose objects are derived complete and whose reductions modulo every positive uniformizer power are finite-torsion constructible in a single finite cohomological interval independent of the power [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Here the specified presentation is exactly $\mathrm{boundedConstructibleDerivedCompleteIntegralCategory}(D,\ell,\ell\ne p,\widetilde E,Y)$, with its functors $\mathrm{integralDerivedReduction}$. Set $C_E^{\mathrm{old}}=\mathcal A_E^{\mathrm{old}}[1/\varpi_E]$, the raw Hom scalar localization [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], namely $\mathrm{rationalConstructibleCategory}(D,\ell,\ell\ne p,\widetilde E,Y)$. Its scalar transition $T^{\mathrm{old}}_{EL}$ is $\mathrm{rationalScalarExtension}$ along $i_{EL}$. These named presentations specify the categories and maps in the assertions below; no identification with a different presentation of the integral predicate is asserted.

Let $\alpha_{ELM}:T^{\mathrm{old}}_{LM}T^{\mathrm{old}}_{EL}\cong T^{\mathrm{old}}_{EM}$ be the tensor associator [lem-weil-scalar-extension-composition] transported along $i_{LM}i_{EL}=i_{EM}$ [lem-route-coefficient-inclusion-laws]. Direct equality transport of the tensor associator equals its composite with the equality isomorphism. These specified $\alpha$ satisfy
$$T^{\mathrm{old}}_{MN}(\alpha_{ELM})\,;\,\alpha_{EMN}=\alpha_{LMN}T^{\mathrm{old}}_{EL}\,;\,\alpha_{ELN}$$
for every $E\le L\le M\le N$, including repeated fields; semicolons mean composition in the order written. Consequently there is exactly one stage system on these fixed categories whose functors are the stated $T^{\mathrm{old}}$ and whose associators are the stated equality-transported tensor isomorphisms [def-sf-directed-common-stage-data].

source.note: Construction material from old argument 5 (retained verbatim): For the retained finite-field interface AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients, conjugate coefficient inclusions by Shrink.algEquiv. Their identity and composition laws follow by cancellation. Transport the tensor associator directly along equality of coefficient maps; equality induction proves it is the original composition with the equality iso. Specialize the normalized tensor pentagon. Equality of all functors and associators uniquely fixes the resulting stage system. Expand each inclusion as s_L inverse, subtype inclusion, s_E. Cancel s_L with its inverse to obtain the identity and composition equations already stated by lem-route-coefficient-inclusion-laws. Eliminate the equality of coefficient maps to reduce correctedTensorAssociator_formula to the original tensor isomorphism followed by eqToIso(rfl). In the pentagon, eliminate the three composite-map equalities; the remaining equation is rationalConstructibleScalar_coherence. Substitution gives the displayed cocycle. For uniqueness, extensionality identifies every functor field, then every associator field by the specified heterogeneous equality; the remaining cocycle field is a proof.

proof.text: Apply the current inclusion-laws statement with $K=\mathbf Q_\ell$ and the fixed site universe $u$. Its $C_E=\operatorname{Shrink}^{u}(E)$ and canonical $s_E$ are the specified $\widetilde E,s_E$; its smallness witness is coefficientSmall. Thus its $j_h=s_L^{-1}\iota_hs_E$ is exactly $i_{EL}$. The displayed laws give $i_{EE}=1$ and $i_{LM}i_{EL}=i_{EM}$, including repeated fields. Applying composition twice gives both triple composites equal to $i_{EN}$. No equality of the coefficient-closure and site universes, or identification of integral predicates, is needed.

Write $a(j,i):T_jT_i\cong T_{ji}$ for the specified older tensor comparison. For an equality $e:ji=v$, define its direct transport $a^e:T_jT_i\cong T_v$. Equality induction on $e$ reduces $a^e=a(j,i);\operatorname{eqToIso}(T_e)$ to $a=a;1$. This proves the asserted direct-transport formula, including its inverse, for the actual comparison rather than an arbitrary isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the untransported pentagon to $i=i_{EL}$, $j=i_{LM}$, $h=i_{MN}$. In the current inclusion-laws statement, $j_k\circ j_h=j_{h\,\mathrm{trans}\,k}$ supplies each composite-map equality through the identification in Step 1. First replace $i_{EM}$ by $ji$, then $i_{LN}$ by $hj$, and finally $i_{EN}$ by $h(ji)$. Equality induction makes these three transport equalities reflexive. The fourth equality $(hj)i=h(ji)$ is associativity of composition; proof irrelevance identifies its chosen proof with reflexivity. Step 2 removes all equality isomorphisms. The two sides become $T_h(a(j,i));a(h,ji)$ and $a(h,j)T_i;a(hj,i)$, equal by the cited pentagon. Reversing the replacements gives the displayed cocycle, including repeated fields.

proof.text: By the stage-system definition the only fields are the transition functors, associators, and their cocycle proof. Set the first two fields to $T^{\mathrm{old}}$ and $\alpha$, and fill the last field by Step 3. This constructs a stage system on exactly the fixed categories; no unitor or equality $T_{EE}=1$ is required.

proof.text: For any other system with these prescribed fields, function extensionality identifies its transition family with the constructed one. After this substitution the stipulated heterogeneous equalities of associators are ordinary equalities; function extensionality identifies the associator family too. The sole remaining field is a proof of the same cocycle proposition, hence equal by proof irrelevance. The structures are equal, proving the claimed unique existence.

lean.statement:
theorem stageSystem_existsUnique :
    ∃! S : StageSystem (Stage D l hl Ω Y),
      (∀ (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L), S.T h = transition D l hl Ω Y E L h) ∧
      (∀ (E L M : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) (k : L ≤ M),
        HEq (S.assoc h k) (associator D l hl Ω Y E L M h k))
lean.note: Exact existing legacy-presentation match: correctedTensorAssociator_formula gives direct transport = tensor comparison followed by eqToIso; associator_formula identifies the sealed associator with tensorAssociator; associator_cocycle gives the displayed four-field equation; stageSystem_existsUnique gives unique existence with precisely the prescribed transitions and associators. Stage uses rationalConstructibleCategory on boundedConstructibleDerivedCompleteIntegralCategory and transition uses rationalScalarExtension; no identification with the intrinsic sfIntegralConstructible/sfRationalConstructibleCategory presentation is made. No new module.
